If the injectors are replaced the following must be taken into account:The Bosch number and class to which it belongs (1, 2, 3 or 2C inside a rim), which is determined according to the amount of fuel injected into the "emission" control point, is etched, by laser, on each injector on the top part of the magnet.If an injector is being replaced, a new injector of the same grade must be fitted.
